Synopsis:
    Solvay is doubling ultra-pure hydrogen peroxide capacity in Taiwan (35k → 70k+ tonnes) by end-2026 via its Shinsol JV, directly tied to TSMC's advanced node fab expansion driven by AI demand. The electronics peroxide unit (15% of total peroxides) is targeted to triple its contribution within 5-7 years. Solvay is also investing in Germany and positioning in the US. The broader high-purity peroxide market is projected to grow at 5.31% annually through 2031, outpacing the overall market, led by sub-5nm fab buildout in Asia-Pacific and North America.

Q01. Is the content relevant to US economy, US yields, US interest rates and US stock market pricing?
Relevance: IMPLICIT — The article signals continued AI-driven semiconductor capex momentum, relevant to US semiconductor supply chain names (chip equipment, materials) and reinforces the AI infrastructure investment theme underpinning NQ/QQQ pricing. No direct US macro or rates angle.

Risk score: 15 — This is largely confirmatory. AI-driven chip demand and TSMC fab expansion are well-documented themes. Solvay's capacity move is incremental detail within an already established narrative, not a surprise signal.
